preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 200000 and isinstance(k, int) and 1 <= k <= 10**9 for n, k in test_cases_params)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is between 1 and 2*10^5, and k is between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) and len(s) == n and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in s) for n, s in zip(test_cases_params, test_cases_strings))
preconditions.description: Each string s has length n and consists only of lowercase Latin letters.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2*10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and len(line) == n and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in line) for line, n in zip(output_lines, [n for n, _ in test_cases_params]))
postconditions.description: Each output line is a string of length n consisting of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: all(is_lexicographically_minimal_reachable(s, k, result) for s, k, result in zip(test_cases_strings, [k for _, k in test_cases_params], output_lines))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output string is the lexicographically smallest string reachable from the input string s using at most k operations.
